market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure as rate-hike expectations collide with a stalling economy. Housing data and bank earnings will dominate. Small-cap metals and gas names offer relative outperformance. Expect volatility around RBA communications.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds in housing and iron ore offset by AI capex, EV transition, and critical-mines demand. A 'bull case returns' narrative exists but requires RBA to pivot and housing to stabilise. 6–12 month path is choppy with sector rotation favouring energy, gold, and tech over property and construction.
